transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well... what scared me enough to actually come in today is that I've been hearing my name being called. 

It happens from the hallway at home, and it even happened once at the warehouse where I work when I knew nobody else was around. It's not just a faint noise, either. It sounds exactly as real as my husband standing right next to me. It really spooked me, so I figured I needed to talk to somebody about it.
Aside from hearing these voices, have you been experiencing any unusual changes in your mood, such as feeling extremely energetic and unable to sleep, or feeling profoundly sad and hopeless?

Well... I haven't really felt sad or hopeless. But energetic, yeah. At first, I just felt really fired up. Like I was almost unstoppable when it came to my craft business and laying down the house rules. 

But then... I don't know, it wasn't just good energy. I would just snap at my husband over the smallest little comment. It just felt like he was trying to hold me back. So, yeah, my mood has definitely been pretty intense lately.
Are you only hearing these voices when your mood feels this intense and energetic, or do you hear them even when your mood is feeling more like your usual self?

Well, it's... it's really only when my mood is like that. The voice calling my name only happened during that stretch when I was barely sleeping. I was talking nonstop, just feeling completely driven to fix everything around me. 

Before that, I didn't hear anything. And once I fell into the low, withdrawn period, I haven't had any voices or... or beliefs like that, either. So it really just seems tied to that specific time when I was all fired up.
During that time when you were feeling 'fired up' and energetic, did you start to feel like you had special powers, or perhaps that people were working against you or monitoring you?

No, I didn't feel like I had any special powers or anything like that. And I didn't think anyone was monitoring me or out to get me. I just felt really capable and focused on what I was doing, but I didn't have any thoughts like that.
During that time when you were feeling 'fired up' and energetic, did your behavior or the things you were doing cause significant problems for you at work or in your relationships?

Yeah, it... it did cause some problems. At work, I guess I was just going too fast or not paying attention, because I made enough inventory mistakes that my supervisor actually had to pull me aside. And at home, my husband has been handling a lot more of the bills and our normal routines because I'm just... I haven't been keeping up with it all. 

I've also completely stopped showing up for my volunteer shifts at the church pantry, and I dropped out of my book club. That's really not like me at all, but things just kind of got out of hand.
